messages:
maria_dev: quick heads-up — i'm going to spin up nova-mini-3b on dev-staging for a short sanity pass. goal is fast checks: trivial correctness, hallucination spot-check, int8 quant smoke, and basic latency numbers.

maria_dev: can someone take the quant path + small eval harness? should be <10m. priority: correctness > perf. :clock1:

kai: I can do the quant smoke. will run int8 conversion on a single GPU, run 50 prompt samples, and report EM/avg-token-latency. starting now.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: model=nova-mini-3b env=dev-staging user=maria_dev run=1765432100-step1

zane: quick devstg curl check after deploy (raw):
```
curl -s -X POST https://dev.api.redwood/model/nova-mini-3b/generate -d '{"prompt":"What is 2+2?","max_tokens":5}'
=> {"text":"4"}
latency-ms: 92
```
response looks fine for basic completion.

ajensen: i've queued a small eval job (eval-harness job id 9876) with math/basic-coherence & a short multi-turn set. artifacts -> s3://redwood-evals/devstaging/9876/

kai: int8 pass finished: conversion ok, no runtime crashes. EM on toy-math set: 98/100. sample hallucination check: 2/50 had extra invented facts in long context. P95 latency: 210ms (single request), batching disabled. attaching quick logs snippet.

sre_oncall: watch for kv cache OOM with long-contexts — last week a similar config hit 6.5GB GPU while building cache. if running multi-turn evals, set KV cache limit to 4k tokens or tune batch size.

olivia_pm: flagging: if we see multi-turn regressions, we need to compare to baseline (gulliver4b) on customer X flows. prioritize those if failures > 3%.

maria_dev: noted. next steps: 1) ajensen, pull eval diff vs baseline and surface any regressions; 2) kai, re-run quant with kv-cache disabled for long contexts; 3) zane, run small A/B on latency-critical prompt set. report back in this thread. :thumbsup:

zane: A/B started, will ping results in ~15m. initial anecdotal: int8 latency lower by ~12% but slight degrade on long-context factuality.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: model=nova-mini-3b env=dev-staging run=1765432100 status=ok

ajensen: eval diff uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/devstaging/9876/diff.html — short summary: pass on basic tasks, 3.8% regression on multi-turn factuality vs baseline, mostly when the prompt contains long lists.

maria_dev: thanks all. if regression persists after disabling kv-cache we'll mark for deeper quality triage; otherwise we can promote to extended staging. closing quick bring-up, will open follow-up if needed.

sre_oncall: note logged: "watch/kvcache/oom" and set alert threshold to 75% of GPU mem for this model on dev-staging.
